description: Web framework for the BEAM, usable from Erlang, Elixir and LFE. Routing, controllers, plugins, WebSockets, pub/sub, sessions and ErlyDTL views on top of Cowboy.
rules: Controllers are arity-1 functions that take the request map and return a handler tuple: {json, Map}, {json, Status, Headers, Map}, {ok, Variables}, {view, Variables}, {status, Code} or {redirect, Path}.
Routes live in the app's router module: routes/1 returns a list of maps with prefix, security and routes, where each route is {Path, {Module, Function}}.
security is false or a fun Module:Function/1, and applies to every route in that group.
A decoded JSON body appears under the json key of the request map only when nova_request_plugin is configured with decode_json_body => true.
Scaffold new apps with rebar3 new nova my_app (from the rebar3_nova plugin) and run them with rebar3 nova serve for auto-reload.
